Summarize this external code review in 1-3 concise sentences. Focus on WHAT the reviewer wants changed, not boilerplate. Strip tool share links, HTML tags, promotional text.

## Inline Code Comments
- tests/container-images/verify_release_config.sh:117: **`pip_extras` regex excludes valid hyphenated extra names**

The validation pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$` does not allow hyphens. PEP 508 defines extra names using the same normalized identifier rules as package names, which permit hyphens (e.g. `oslo-messaging`, `oslo-policy`). The current three extras (`ldap`, `memcache_pool`, `oauth1`) all match, but any future OpenStack service extra that uses a hyphen would be incorrectly rejected by this test.

Aligning the pip extras pattern to also allow hyphens would keep the test in sync with the spec:

```suggestion
  bad_extras=$(yq '.keystone.pip_extras[]' "$extra_packages" \
    | tr -d '"' | grep -vE '^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$' || true)
```
